name: Kedesh
overview: Kedesh is a biblically significant city with multiple references in Scripture, highlighting its distinct identities. It is noted as a city within the tribe of Judah and is possibly the same as Kadesh-Barnea, as seen in Joshua 15:23 and Joshua 12:22. Additionally, Kedesh is identified with Kishion or Kishon, a Canaanite city captured by Joshua (Joshua 19:20; Joshua 21:28). Importantly, Kedesh in Galilee, located in the territory of Naphtali, served as a city of refuge, providing sanctuary for those who unintentionally committed manslaughter (Joshua 20:7; Joshua 21:32). This city also holds historical significance as the home of Barak and Heber and was later captured by Tiglath-pileser, underscoring its role in Israel's history and God's provision of justice and protection.
